author: irex681
body:
Hey guys, while i'm in Bulgaria i don't have much internet,  but I have some downtime on single player. So.. I made another map. This time it was made solo. :o

Sky Kingdom - (Any better names, please suggest)

-Gamemode - C/DTM Nebula

Pictures - http://imgur.com/a/1odA2

Download - Will have it shortly.

-YAML - Will have it shortly. Can I talk to someone about something I want to add?

So yeah, I hope you like it! I've been working on it for quite some time! I will be open to suggestions and things you might  want me to add.
